page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top: "De Episcopatu" left, "Q. VII." right. Page number "72" at the top left. No margin notes. Catchword "modo" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: gistratus inspectione tanquam utriusque tabulæ custode non eximimus. Et postquam dixissent, hanc potestatem per provocationem aut appellationem proprie dictam non posse ad Magistratus aut Principum tribunal deferri, addunt: interim tamen non diffi-temur verum esse, quod Bezæ adversum Erastum fatetur; cum etiam a recte constituto consistorio possit reis delatis injuria fieri; in angustioribus territoriis citra ullam &c. & allegant omnia illa verba Bezæ modo a nobis citata. Item disputat. de Magistratu th. 47. proprie jus est penes Pastores disciplinam Ecclesiasticam, unà cum suo presbyterio ex fidei & sacræ doctrinæ analogia decernendi: Magistratus vero penes quem est summa imperii potestas disciplinam illam aut præsens approbare, aut absens examinare potest, & si quid in eâ jure desideretur, à Pastoribus exigere, ut illud ex verbi Dei analogia addatur vel emendetur. Cl. Walæus p. 48. etiam allegat & approbat sententiam ac verba Bezæ

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("gistratus"), the start of "magistratus", cut off by the scan edge. Italic and roman boundaries in the body are approximate where the scan is faint, especially around "Bezæ" and "quod". "Magistratu th." may be a mis-set abbreviation; kept as printed. The running head is split across the top line, so both parts are given. "Cum" and "a" are kept as printed, with no accent marks.
